aboutPage.heading: About Asharu
aboutPage.lead: Asharu (asharu.id) is a digital hub that consolidates all of our online channels: shops, curated affiliate products, social media, and properties.
aboutPage.purposeBody: Instead of scattering information across many platforms, we centralise everything under one memorable address. Looking for our shop? It's here. Want curated product picks? Here. Searching for a property? Also here.
aboutPage.principlesIntro: Three principles guide everything we publish across Asharu:
aboutPage.principle1Body: Every affiliate link is labelled clearly before you click it. No cloaked links.
aboutPage.principle2Body: We do not display prices, certificates, or claims that cannot be verified. When something is uncertain, we say so.
aboutPage.principle3Body: This site processes no payments. Purchases and negotiations happen on official marketplaces or through our official contact.
aboutPage.contactBody: For questions, data corrections, or partnerships, please use the contact channels listed on the homepage.

privacyPage.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This document explains what data is processed when you visit asharu.id, the basis for that processing, and how you stay in control.
privacyPage.s1p1: Asharu has no user accounts, forms, or checkout. We do not ask for and do not store your name, email address, phone number, or message contents on this site.
privacyPage.s1p2: The only storage on your device is your analytics consent preference, kept in your browser's localStorage.
privacyPage.s2p1: If you grant consent, we use Google Analytics 4 for aggregate visit statistics (pages viewed, device type, traffic source). Google Analytics is not loaded at all before you agree.
privacyPage.s2p2: We never send personal data — names, emails, phone numbers, or full property addresses — to Google Analytics. You can withdraw consent at any time via the "Analytics preferences" link in the footer of every page.
privacyPage.s3p1: This site uses no tracking cookies. Language preference and analytics consent status are stored in localStorage, accessed only by this site, and sent nowhere unless you consent to analytics.
privacyPage.s4p1: These pages contain links to third-party marketplaces, social networks, and merchants. Once you leave asharu.id, the destination platform's privacy policy applies. We recommend reading it before sharing personal data there.
privacyPage.s5p1: You can refuse or withdraw analytics consent at any time via the preferences link in the footer. To erase all local traces, clear asharu.id site data in your browser settings.
privacyPage.s6p1: When this policy changes, the date at the top of the page will be revised, and material changes will be announced on our social channels.
privacyPage.s7p1: Questions about this document can be raised through the official contact channels listed on the homepage.

disclosurePage.heading: Affiliate Disclosure
disclosurePage.intro: This page explains Asharu's relationship with merchant and marketplace partners, so you can judge our recommendations with full context.
disclosurePage.howP1: Some product links on this site are affiliate links: if you make a purchase after clicking one, Asharu may receive a commission from the platform or merchant, as defined by each platform's affiliate program.
disclosurePage.howP2: What matters to you: this commission never makes your purchase more expensive. The price you see on the seller's platform is the same price every buyer pays.
disclosurePage.pricingP1: We do not display real-time prices because we have no live feed into merchant systems. Product cards always point you to the seller's platform for current pricing, and we state plainly that prices may change.
disclosurePage.independenceP1: Decisions about which products appear here are made by the Asharu team, not by merchants. Commissions influence our revenue, not our editorial choices. Products that stop being relevant or develop problems are removed from curation.
disclosurePage.questionsP1: If you have questions about this disclosure or want to report an issue with any link, please reach us through the official contact channels on the homepage.
